audit.whatIsWrong: diff/diffRating/carryRating and every phases[].side said Blitzcrank ('Skill') wins each stage, while the content layer's win[0..6] already said 'Braum' for all seven rows — the two layers disagreed on every single row.
audit.why: Braum's own audited page (braum_sup__blitzcrank) already carries the mirror-consistent verdict: Stand Behind Me body-blocks Rocket Grab and Unbreakable shields the grabbed target, so Braum wins the lane outright (his page: diff FAVOURED 4/10, side='Braum' all 7 rows). Blitzcrank's page must mirror that.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..6].side to 'Braum' (matching win[0..6], no change needed there) and rewrite the seven .why strings to state Braum's win condition per stage instead of Blitzcrank's.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr/winCon/enemyWin/ahead read as Blitzcrank favored ('Out-range the engage war', 'Ahead, fish openly') despite the chart and content layer already saying Braum wins every stage.
audit.why: Real power spikes here run the other way: Braum's W is up before your Q's 16-20s cooldown resets, so he answers your engage far more often than you land it, and it only gets worse post-item as Unbreakable scales.
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr/winCon/enemyWin/ahead to state Braum pre-answering the hook as the core dynamic, and to give the owner a realistic win path (bait W, then hook) instead of implying Blitzcrank is ahead.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d told the reader to commit hooks 'on Unbreakable's cooldown' with no mention of Stand Behind Me (W), which is the ability that actually intercepts Rocket Grab; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Braum W (Stand Behind Me) is a dash to an ally that lets him body-block a targeted projectile like Rocket Grab; Q Winter's Bite/E Unbreakable are the shield/slow layer, not the intercept. Blitzcrank's Q is 20/19/18/17/16s, so a whiffed or blocked hook is a long window.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[0].d to name Stand Behind Me as the actual counter and to key off its cooldown, replaced the pasted trade-good/trade-bad bodies in dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d with content specific to those titles, and rewrote breakdown.cooldowns to include Blitzcrank's real Q cooldown (20/19/18/17/16) and Braum's W cooldown (12/11/10/9/8).
